stories.title: The Little Angel's First Good Deed
stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.blurb: Lily is a little angel with a big heart. When she meets a tiny bluebird who has lost its family, Lily sets off on a gentle adventure to help. Along the way, she discovers that even the smallest act of kindness can make someone's day brighter. A heart-warming bedtime story about compassion, friendship, and the joy of helping others.
pages: High above the clouds
where the sky was bright and peaceful
lived a little angel called Lily.  Lily had soft white wings
a glowing golden halo
and the kindest smile.  She loved helping everyone.  One morning
Lily flew to Angel School.  The teacher smiled at all the little angels.  "Today's lesson is about kindness
" she said.  "Your first good deed doesn't have to be big. Even the smallest act of kindness can make someone's day brighter."  Lily wondered
What kind thing can I do today?  As she flew through the sky
she spotted a tiny bluebird sitting quietly on a branch.  "What's wrong?" Lily asked gently.  "I can't find my family
" chirped the little bird sadly.  "Don't worry
" said Lily. "I'll help you."  Together
they flew from tree to tree.  They looked in the tall trees.  They looked near the little stream.  They even looked beside a colourful flower garden.  At last

they heard cheerful chirping.  "There they are!" cried the little bird.  The bird's family fluttered over with happy little tweets.  "Thank you!" they chirped.  Lily smiled.  Helping someone felt warm and wonderful.  As the sun began to set
Lily returned to Angel School.  "Did you do your first good deed?" asked the teacher.  "Yes
" said Lily with a smile.  "I helped a little bird find its family."  The teacher nodded proudly.  "You gave your time
your kindness

and your caring heart. That is what being an angel is all about."  Lily looked up at the twinkling stars.  She realised that even the smallest act of kindness could make the world a little brighter.  That night
Lily went to sleep with a happy heart
ready for another day of spreading kindness. Bedtime Thought: A small act of kindness can make a big difference.

stories.title: Ruby and the Little Raindrop
stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.blurb: Follow Ruby, a tiny raindrop, as she discovers that even the smallest drop can help flowers bloom and make the world a brighter place.
pages: High above the world
where the clouds floated softly
lived a little raindrop called Ruby.  Ruby loved bouncing around inside the fluffy white clouds.  One morning
the Wind whispered

"It's time to fall to the Earth."  Ruby felt a little nervous.  "What if I fall too fast?" she asked.  "What if I get lost?"  The Cloud gave Ruby a gentle smile.  "Don't be afraid. Every raindrop has a special place to go."  Ruby took a deep breath.  Then...  Plip!  She jumped from the cloud.  She danced through the cool air.  She twirled past birds.  She sparkled in the sunshine.  Soon
Ruby landed with a tiny splash on a thirsty flower.  "Oh
thank you!" said the flower.  "I was so thirsty."  Ruby smiled.  She had helped the flower grow.  As the days went by
the flower bloomed into a beautiful
colourful blossom.  Bees came to visit.  Butterflies fluttered around.  Everyone admired the lovely flower.  Ruby felt proud.  She had been a small raindrop
but she had made a big difference.  From that day on
Ruby was never afraid to fall from the clouds again.  She knew that every little raindrop helps the world bloom.   Bedtime Thought: Even the smallest drop can help something beautiful grow.

stories.title: Ellie the Little Elephant
stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.blurb: Join Ellie on a splashing adventure as she learns that playing is even more fun when everyone joins in.
pages: In a green forest lived a little elephant called Ellie.  Ellie loved splashing in the water.  Splash!  Splash!  Splash!  One warm morning

Ellie ran to the pond.  She splashed with her trunk.  She splashed with her feet.  She splashed so much that water went everywhere!  "Oh!" said Benny the Bunny.  "My ears are all wet!"  "Oh!" said Tilly the Turtle.  "My shell is covered in muddy water!"  Ellie stopped.  "I'm sorry

" she said.  "I was having so much fun."  Benny smiled.  "It's alright."  Tilly smiled too.  "Let's splash together!"  So they all stepped into the pond.  Splash!  Splash!  Splash!  They laughed.  They played.  They cooled down in the warm sunshine.  When it was time to go home
Ellie smiled.  "Playing is even more fun with friends."  From that day on
Ellie always made sure everyone could join the fun.   Bedtime Thought: Playing is more fun when everyone is included.

stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.blurb: Twinkle, a little star, just isn't ready for bed. While all the other stars drift off to sleep, Twinkle stays wide awake. With a little help from the gentle Moon and the peaceful night sky, Twinkle discovers why a good night's sleep is so important. A cosy bedtime story filled with warmth, comfort and sweet dreams.
stories.title: The Little Star Who Couldn't Sleep
pages: High above the world
where the night sky twinkled with thousands of stars
lived a little star called Twinkle.  Every evening
the stars shone brightly before settling down for a peaceful night's sleep.  But not Twinkle.  "I don't feel sleepy
" sighed the little star.  Twinkle floated from cloud to cloud
counted the fluffy clouds
and quietly hummed a little tune.  Still
sleep wouldn't come.  Just then
the gentle Moon noticed.  "Would you like a cosy bedtime cuddle?" asked the Moon with a warm smile.  Twinkle nodded happily.  The Moon wrapped the little star in a blanket of soft
silvery light.  Below
the trees swayed gently in the evening breeze.  The crickets sang their sleepy songs.  The owls softly called
"Hoo... hoo..."  Everything felt peaceful.  Everything felt safe.  Twinkle let out a tiny yawn.  Then another.  "I think I'm ready for bed
" whispered the little star.  The Moon smiled.  "Even the brightest stars need a good night's sleep."  Twinkle closed their little eyes.  Soon
the little star was fast asleep
dreaming of colourful rainbows
fluffy clouds
and happy children making wishes beneath the night sky.  When morning came
Twinkle woke up feeling bright
happy
and full of energy.  "I'm so glad I had a good night's sleep!" smiled Twinkle.  From that day on
Twinkle remembered that a good night's sleep helps every little star shine brightly. Bedtime Thought: A good night's sleep helps us wake up happy
refreshed
and ready for a brand-new day.

stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.title: Benny's Big Yawn
stories.blurb: Join Benny the little bunny as he discovers that bedtime brings sweet dreams and happy mornings.
pages: Benny was a little bunny.  He loved to hop.  Hop!  Hop!  Hop!  One evening
Benny was still hopping.  Mama Bunny smiled.  "It's bedtime
Benny."  "But I'm not sleepy

" said Benny.  He hopped a little more.  Hop!  Hop!  Hop!  Then Benny gave a little yawn.  "Yawn..."  He rubbed his eyes.  Mama Bunny tucked him into his cosy bed.  She gave him a warm cuddle.  She kissed his little nose.  Outside
the stars twinkled.  The Moon smiled.  Benny closed his eyes.  "Goodnight
Mama
" he whispered.  "Goodnight
Benny
" said Mama Bunny.  Soon
Benny was fast asleep.  He dreamed of carrots
flowers
and happy little hops.  Bedtime Thought: A good night's sleep helps little bunnies grow strong and happy.

stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.title: Benji and the Honey Pot
pages: Benji was a little bear.  He loved honey.  One sunny morning
Benji found a little pot of honey.  "Yummy!" said Benji.  Just as he was about to eat it
he heard a tiny voice.  "Hello!"  It was Bella the Bee.  "We made that honey
" she buzzed.  Benji smiled.  "It looks delicious."  Bella had an idea.  "Would you like to share?"  "Yes

please!" said Benji.  Bella poured a little honey into a small bowl.  Benji took one little lick.  "Mmm... Delicious!"  Bella smiled.  Then she shared some honey with her bee friends.  Everyone had enough.  Benji clapped his paws.  "Sharing makes everything sweeter!"  Bella giggled.  "It really does!"  The sun began to set.  Benji waved goodbye.  "Thank you for sharing."  "See you soon!" buzzed Bella.  Benji walked home with a happy heart.  That night
he fell asleep with a big smile on his face.   Bedtime Thought: Sharing with others makes every treat even sweeter.
stories.blurb: A sweet bedtime story about sharing, friendship, and a little pot of honey.

stories.author: Litrishiya Savariraj
stories.title: Gina the Giraffe's Tiny Act of Kindness
stories.blurb: Join Gina the gentle giraffe as she discovers that small acts of kindness can make a big difference.
pages: On the edge of a sunny forest lived a little giraffe called Gina.  Gina had a long neck
gentle eyes
and a kind heart.  Every morning
she loved nibbling on the fresh green leaves at the top of the tallest trees.  One bright morning
Gina noticed something below.  It was Leo
a little koala.  Leo was stretching as high as he could.  "I can't reach the leaves
" he sighed.  Gina smiled.  "I can help!"  She bent her long neck and gently pulled down a leafy branch.  "There you go
" she said.  Leo's face lit up.  "Thank you
Gina!"  A little later
Gina met Penny the Parrot.  "My nest is getting too warm
" said Penny.  Gina stood beside the tree and made a cool patch of shade with her long neck.  "That's much better!" chirped Penny happily.  As Gina walked home
she heard a tiny squeak.  It was Millie the Mouse.  "My ball is stuck under a bush

" she said.  Gina carefully reached down with her long neck and nudged the ball back.  Millie clapped her little paws.  "You've helped everyone today!"  Gina smiled.  "I didn't do anything big."  Just then
Wise Owl flew down from a branch.  "Oh
but you did

" he said.  "Kindness doesn't have to be big. Even a small helping hand can make someone smile."  Gina looked around.  Leo was happily eating.  Penny was resting in the shade.  Millie was playing with her ball.  Seeing her friends happy made Gina's heart feel warm.  That evening
the sky turned pink and gold.  Gina looked up at the twinkling stars.  She smiled.  Helping others had made it the best day ever.  From that day on
Gina looked for little ways to help every day.  And the forest became a happier place because of her kind heart.   Bedtime Thought: Even the smallest act of kindness can make someone's day brighter.
